main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when the supplied access key is expired at the evaluation instant.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether the supplied policy context is expired.
method.returns: Deny when the access key is expired; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether the supplied policy context is expired.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the access key is expired; otherwise allow.
